controls.title: Timeouts and retry policies are bounded
controls.description: Inspect outbound/runtime retry and timeout configuration.
checks: Inspect outbound/runtime retry and timeout configuration.
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Timeouts and retry policies are bounded?
controls.pass_condition: Explicit bounded timeout and retry/attempt configuration signals are both present.
controls.partial_condition: Only timeout or retry/attempt bounds are explicit.
controls.fail_condition: A backend/API surface has no bounded timeout/retry evidence, or retry behavior appears unbounded.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.

controls.title: Dependency failures have graceful degradation or explicit failure modes
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Dependency failures have graceful degradation or explicit failure modes?
controls.pass_condition: PASS when TEST_RESULT evidence directly demonstrates "Dependency failures have graceful degradation or explicit failure modes" for the applicable scope; the review/test addresses this check: Exercise representative dependency loss; and no material contradictory evidence remains.
controls.partial_condition: PARTIAL when evidence for "Dependency failures have graceful degradation or explicit failure modes" exists but is incomplete in scope, freshness, execution, or authority, or when the required check is only partly demonstrated: Exercise representative dependency loss.
controls.fail_condition: FAIL when applicable evidence contradicts "Dependency failures have graceful degradation or explicit failure modes", the required capability is materially absent, or the check cannot be demonstrated after review: Exercise representative dependency loss.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.
